Autumn update for families
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travelers flying with pets should check their booking notes before they arrive, because a few airport routines have changed and the easiest trip is the one planned early.

Pet travel update

Aurelia Skyways wants every family to feel clear on the process. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping a close eye on pet handling, and the cabin team will continue to watch animals carefully during the flight. Please keep your carrier ready, your documents handy, and your communication prompt if anything needs attention. <<FACT F029>>

At Thornwick, the pet relief area and lounge details matter for a smooth handoff, so review the latest airport guidance before you head out. <<FACT F016>> <<FACT F022>> If you are traveling with a nervous pet, tell the desk early so staff can help you move through check-in with less stress. Lucia Moretti and Arjun Berg, if you are reading this, the same advice applies to you and to Milo, too.

The short version is simple: stay in touch, follow staff directions, and give every animal the patient care they deserve. For help with any pet travel concern, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
